name: Last Bet
source:
Around 4:30 pm on June 5th, a fourteen-year-old male student from a private junior high school fell from the school roof. He passed shortly after at the hospital he was transferred to.

The police assumed it to have been an accident and closed the investigation. An unfortunate happening. Something no one had been planning or could have predicted.

Is it okay to let this tragedy be filed as a mere accident?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5194]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
6月5日下午4时30分左右，一名民办初中14岁男学生从学校屋顶坠落。他在被转移到的医院后不久就去世了。

警方认为这是一起事故并结束了调查。不幸的事情发生了。没有人计划或无法预测的事情。

难道就让这场悲剧仅仅被归结为一场意外吗？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5194]NovelGame[/url]]
